alerts.headline: Special Weather Statement issued July 24 at 7:18PM CDT by NWS Lubbock TX
alerts.description:
At 714 PM CDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong outflow boundary
along a line extending from 4 miles south of Pep to 9 miles
northeast of Seagraves Airport. Movement was east at 35 mph.  This
boundary may contain wind gusts of up to 55 mph along with areas of
blowing dust.  While there is uncertainty regards to if this
boundary will maintain its speed, it may reach the I-27 and US 87
corridor by around 8 pm.  Thus far, the peak mesonet wind reported
with this activity has been 42 mph though we have seen higher winds
over time with boundaries like this over the past several evenings.

HAZARD...Wind gusts of 50 to 55 mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects.

Locations impacted include...
Lubbock, Levelland, Brownfield, Slaton, Abernathy, Tahoka, Wolfforth,
Shallowater, Idalou, Sundown, Anton, Ransom Canyon, O'Donnell, New
Moore, Lubbock South Plains Mall, Locketville, Slide, Woodrow, Reese
Center, and Lubbock International Airport.
